An Exceptional Opportunity in Erinvale Golf Estate Set within the prestigious Erinvale Golf Estate, this beautifully positioned home presents an exceptional opportunity to enjoy secure estate living, breathtaking mountain views and a lifestyle that can be appreciated for years to come. From the moment you step inside, the abundance of natural light creates an inviting sense of warmth and space. Generous windows and glass doors allow sunlight to flow throughout the home, while the spacious living areas connect effortlessly with the outdoors, creating the perfect setting for both relaxed everyday living and entertaining. The beautifully established gardens provide a peaceful, colourful backdrop, with manicured lawns, mature greenery and magnificent views of the surrounding mountains. Upstairs, a generous balcony offers an incredible vantage point from which to soak in the scenery, enjoy your morning coffee or simply appreciate the tranquillity of this remarkable setting. The home offers multiple living and entertaining areas, a well-appointed kitchen with ample cabinetry and a separate utility area, as well as comfortable bedrooms filled with natural light. High ceilings and expansive windows in the upstairs rooms further enhance the feeling of openness, with beautiful mountain views adding something special to everyday living. What truly sets this property apart is its thoughtful approach to long-term comfort and convenience. With a wheelchair lift providing access between levels, this is a home that allows you to plan for the future without having to compromise on the lifestyle you love. Whether you're looking for a forever home or simply value the reassurance of additional accessibility, this feature offers a wonderful sense of flexibility and peace of mind. A spacious double garage with additional storage cabinetry adds further practicality to the home. Located within one of Somerset West's most sought-after estates, residents can enjoy the beauty of the surrounding landscape, the tranquillity of secure estate living and the exceptional lifestyle associated with Erinvale. More than just a property, this is an opportunity to invest in a lifestyle, create lasting memories and find a place to call home for a lifetime. Contact us today to arrange your private viewing and experience everything this exceptional property has to offer.
